name: Custom Fabrication Inc
old_description: At Custom Fabrication Inc, we specialize in the fabrication of aluminum, stainless, and other metals. Our services include welding, laser cutting, forming, and shearing to create custom parts and components for your project. With our state-of-the-art equipment, we can create high-quality metal products that meet your exact specifications.
